statement.essentials: Most lumps in the parotid are benign, and the most common is a pleomorphic adenoma.
statement.anatomy: Pleomorphic adenoma is the most common salivary gland neoplasm and arises most often in the parotid.

limitations: Secondary source; the share of Warthin tumour has risen in some regions (Franzen 2018), so proportions vary by era and place.
